camel_example: aliyun dms UpdateMyAgenticNotificationChannelConfig --region cn-hangzhou --Channel FEISHU --version 2025-04-14 --method POST --force
description_en: Updates the notification channel switch or Lark account binding information for the current user
description_zh: 修改当前用户的通知渠道开关或飞书账号绑定信息
name: UpdateMyAgenticNotificationChannelConfig

parameters.help_en: The notification channel type. Currently, only FEISHU (Lark) is supported. Specifying other values results in a parameter error
parameters.help_zh: 通知渠道类型。当前仅支持 FEISHU（飞书国内版），传入其他值会返回参数错误
parameters.name: channel

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to enable the notification channel. If this parameter is not specified, the original value is retained. When you only modify the switch, the Config parameter is not required, and the existing binding information remains unchanged
parameters.help_zh: 是否开启通知渠道。不传时保持原值。只修改开关时无需传入 Config，已有绑定信息保持不变
parameters.name: enabled

parameters.help_en: The channel configuration in the format of a JSON object string. This parameter is not required if you do not update the binding information. Supports mobile (phone number) or email. You can bind or rebind a Lark account by using one of them at a time. If the existing masked values of mobile or email are passed as ******, they are not modified. openId is a read-only field and cannot be specified
parameters.help_zh: 渠道配置，格式为 JSON 对象字符串。不更新绑定信息时可不传。支持 mobile（手机号）或 email（邮箱），每次通过其中一个绑定或换绑飞书账号。已有 mobile、email 的脱敏值 ****** 原样传入时不修改。openId 为只读字段，不支持传入
parameters.name: config

Data.description_zh: 修改后的通知渠道配置

Channel.description_en: The notification channel type. Valid values: FEISHU (Lark)
Channel.description_zh: 通知渠道类型。取值：FEISHU（飞书国内版）

additionalProperties.description_en: The value of the configuration item. Sensitive values such as openId, mobile, and email are always displayed as ****** in the actual response
additionalProperties.description_zh: 配置项的取值。openId、mobile、email 等敏感值在实际返回时固定显示为 ******

Config.description_en: The channel configuration information. Both keys and values are strings, including the bound identity information such as openId, mobile, or email. Sensitive values are always displayed as ******, and plaintext is not returned
Config.description_zh: 渠道配置信息，键和值均为字符串，包含已绑定的身份信息（如 openId、mobile 或 email）。敏感值固定显示为 ******，不返回明文

Enabled.description_en: Indicates whether the notification channel is enabled. Returns false if the channel has never been configured
Enabled.description_zh: 是否已开启该通知渠道。从未配置过该渠道时返回 false

ErrorCode.description_en: The error code returned when the request fails
ErrorCode.description_zh: 请求失败时返回的错误码

ErrorMessage.description_en: The error message returned when the request fails
ErrorMessage.description_zh: 请求失败时返回的错误信息

Success.description_en: Indicates whether the request is successful. Valid values: true: The request is successful. false: The request fails
Success.description_zh: 请求是否成功。取值：true 表示成功，false 表示失败
